notablePrerequisites: Basic lands you control can tap to produce at least {6}{G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
description:
Activate all basic lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {6}{G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Early Harvest by paying {1}{G}{G}, untapping all basic lands you control.
Activate Shigeki's channel ability by paying {4}{G}{G} and discarding it, returning Early Harvest and Regrowth from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Regrowth by paying {1}{G}, returning Shigeki to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.
If basic lands you control can tap to produce at least {7}{G}{G}{G}{G}{G}, this combo nets infinite mana.
